primitiveBudget: twelve generated WebGL membrane cells, triangulated front facets, extruded side planes, four remote resistance transfers
renderer: p5.js 1.11.3 WEBGL faceted membrane with WebGPU capability signal
memoryRule: a trace remains geometry-neutral until it crosses grain alignment and span resistance; the traced cell stays exact while an untouched remote facet gains new triangulation, warp, depth, and ridge; four transfers persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch traces across the membrane; Enter or Space makes an equivalent deterministic grain trace; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas depth sheets, raster waiting fossil, and kinetic witness shards -> one generated WEBGL membrane whose material is its facet topology
compositionRupture: nine depth sheets, one mineral body, and a broken current -> a single suspended oblique membrane of hinged cells with a deep underside
encounterRupture: three-witness accord, duration hold, and closed circuit -> find and cross a directional grain; the touched site does not answer
temporalRupture: remote reorder, remote hardening, and remote shadow -> repeated resistance transfers re-triangulate a remote facet without resetting earlier changes
mediumRupture: Canvas 2D sheets, raster fossil, and Canvas kinetic field -> p5.js WEBGL custom triangular faces, extruded sides, and generated facet ridges
changedRule: Material is a threshold, not a surface: a trace must follow the membrane's grain and cross its resistance. Only then is the event spent in an untouched remote facet; the traced cell remains exact.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a suspended three-dimensional membrane of twelve unequal faceted cells. A valid trace leaves its source untouched while a remote cell becomes deeper, more triangulated, warped, and ridged; four transfers compound.
falsifier: Delete if an incomplete or misaligned trace changes geometry, if the touched cell changes, if remote resistance is only colour or readout, if every receiver is identical, if later transfers reset, if the membrane reads as generic 3D tiles, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v043 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the resistance membrane from v040-v042 or if material resistance does not visibly alter how a remote facet is produced.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
